user.title: Connect Panasonic China appliances
user.description: Connect mainland China Panasonic appliances. The maintainer confirms the existing purifier and AC controls are usable. Some refrigerator controls still need validation; other models are not guaranteed compatible. Entity actions or your own automations can control devices. Setup and polling do not send controls, and commands are not retried. HA stores credentials in configuration entries; protect configuration files and backups.

reconfigure.title: Change Panasonic account or password
reconfigure.description: Enter credentials locally. Login and supported-device discovery are checked before saving and reloading. A failed check does not replace existing credentials. Identifiers are preserved for the same device.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed ({detail}). Only a safe request stage, error category, and numeric code are shown. Credentials and raw responses are omitted; existing configuration is unchanged.
error.no_devices: No supported device protocol found: F-75C5PJD / AirconCommon-2024-01 / Fridge-19.
